channel.title: Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily picks of tech opinions and blog posts for 周运.

item.title: Satya Nadella: Models as Insider Risks in the Super Intelligence Era
item.description: Nadella argues enterprises should treat frontier models as insider risks: separate "the supply of intelligence from the authority over it" — identity, least privilege, tamper-proof logs, and a human-held emergency brake — conceding that models can't be trusted, only contained.

item.title: Andrej Karpathy: the AI capability funnel is sharpening
item.description: Karpathy follows up his April post: ~6B people have barely touched an LLM, 1–2B are casual users, ~20M use frontier models professionally in math/code, and only ~5,000 see frontier systems from the inside — everyone is debating a different machine.

item.title: Brookings: Shaping global governance of AI agents
item.description: Agents shift governance from "what did the model say" to "what did the system do, why was it allowed, and who is accountable" — and with the EU's high-risk rules delayed to 2027–28, organizational controls, not law, govern agents in high-stakes domains for now.

item.title: Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis) on Big Technology: Can AI Keep Growing Exponentially?
item.description: Patel argues the circulating AI-buildout numbers are still too small, compute demand keeps outrunning supply, and value shifts from labor to capital — including why AI labs might keep their best models to themselves.
